source.build: Release CLI build: -j16 stopped before OOM when available RAM fell below 6 GiB; resumed at -j8 and succeeded.

strict_native_vulkan_nvenc_t16_150_frame.blackdetect: no black interval detected at d=0.001,pix_th=0.015

dof_on_frame0.result: visible complete composition; soft halo around cutout remains a quality concern

three_layer_frame0.result: visible background, title, and foreground subject

strict_native_vulkan_nvenc_t16_150_frame.root_cause: Two native-path defects were present: there was no Vulkan memory dependency between Render Graph levels, and the terminal DoF output could retain a distinct surface from the NVENC encode surface with no native device-to-device copy lane. The level barrier and terminal encode-surface copy restore the available T16 output.
strict_native_vulkan_nvenc_t16_150_frame.limitation: Issue #67 exact 240-frame plan/source and RTX 4060 Ti remain unavailable; this is a current-source RTX A4000 T16 150-frame reproduction.

comparison_to_vulkan_dof_on_frame0.result: Vulkan closely matches software; visible softness/edge halo is also present in software

verification.repeatability: SHA-256 matches the prior successful 150-frame T16 run

T01_parallax.evidence: Historical CAM-02 isolated camera test passed; documentary scene integration not run.

T02_title_occlusion_alpha.evidence: Current T16 software and Vulkan raw frame visibly show subject in front of title; no full edge/alpha gate run.

T03_depth_of_field.evidence: Strict-native DoF-off and DoF-on one-frame MP4s decode as visible complete compositions; the 150-frame DoF-on T16 render decodes without black intervals. The subject cutout still shows a visible soft halo, and no edge-quality acceptance threshold has been agreed. Plan inspection: camera-space focus distance is 1000; foreground subject plane is approximately 901 units from the camera (camera z=-1000, subject layer z=-99), so the plan itself places the subject in front of the focus plane. The visible softness is consistent with that authoring, but the desired edge look remains a visual decision.

T05_shutter_motion_blur.evidence: Existing documented 150-frame gate: 111 pass, 39 fail; focused frame-75 check alone passed.

T06_determinism_cache_random_access.evidence: Requested 240-frame sequential/random/repeat job not run on this current scene.

T07_landscape_portrait.evidence: Portrait-authored plan and paired renders unavailable.

T08_mp4_gpu_stress.evidence: Fresh current-source strict-native NVENC export passed 150/150 frames at 1920x1080/30 fps; full ffprobe decode and blackdetect passed and output SHA matches the earlier passing run. Issue #67 exact 240-frame plan, three consecutive jobs, and RTX 4060 Ti rerun remain unavailable.

verdict.NATIVE_READY: PARTIAL: available T16 plan passes; issue #67 exact reproduction not available

limitations: The exact 240-frame plan and source checkout referenced by issue #67 are unavailable in this workspace.
The original issue environment was an RTX 4060 Ti; the available reproduction passed on an RTX A4000.
The requested burger, fries, and cup transparent production assets are unavailable.
DoF renders without black frames, but the subject cutout shows a visible soft halo and lacks an agreed quality gate.
Portrait framing, random-access determinism, motion-blur full-sequence parity, and three consecutive native stress jobs remain unverified.
